reproduction.instructions: Start an isolated :99 Xvfb and PASEO_NATIVE_QA fixture.mts with node --import tsx. Seed a b and opaque.keep=17 on the Grok-labelled Node profile (original fixture seed has only program args). Copy the helpers into that private directory and create processes.json/launch the private binary. qa.py expects workspace B retained as an empty main launcher and the original three profiles; qa-extra.py expects its retained result and workspace A raw PTY. GUI coordinates are global for a 1280x800 window at 162,100. Reference uses TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=packages/app/tsconfig.json and requires that cached Expo export. Never point helpers at production or real agents. Temporary fixture paths and IDs in evidence belong to this closed run; recreate them rather than reuse them. Evidence TypeScript copies use repository-relative imports. The executed private copies resolved those imports to this checkout; translate imports if copying them outside the repository, or keep the client beside this evidence and update the Python helper client path. Logs normalize line-end whitespace; raw output remains in the private cache.
